text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As lunch break was nearing its end,
I was walking down the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you see... Rice loves how much you
enjoy reading, Rob Roy-san. But you know,
Rice also cares a lot about your health...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry,
I've made you worry yet again...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san... Actually,
I forgot to eat lunch...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I got so engrossed in my novel
that I completely lost track of time...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's always like this lately... I get so absorbed in reading that I forget to eat meals...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're starving, aren't you...?
Rice will make lots of yummy things for our next tea party...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Hehe, the tea party preparations are coming along nicely, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I've done thorough research and gathered precise recipes,
and I've already arranged for all the necessary supplies...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, Rice is looking forward to it so much...!
I can hardly wait... hehe.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right...
Um... Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, Trainer,
would you care to join our tea party...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the tea party, I headed to the designated corner
of the courtyard, only to find tables and chairs
all lined up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy-san, I finished spreading the tablecloth!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Now, let's place these teacups and
saucers—ah, and also this enamel
milk pitcher in the center.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah... looks great!
It really feels like we're in Europe...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Fufu... "The engineer languidly poured milk from an old enamel pitcher" was a passage I absolutely had to recreate...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um, next I'll set out the bone china plates I bought at the flea market—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome...! Today, I'm recreating
a dish that appears in the classic British novel,
"A Christmas Carrot"...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So, while looking up recipes,
I ended up being really particular about everything.
Ehehe...
choice_data_list: Recreating a dish from a novel sounds fun!
Recreating a dish from a novel sounds fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Actually, Rice-san was the one who first came up with the idea.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Recreating a tea party from a book...
Oh, that sounds so much fun...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
R-Really?
Rice has always, always wanted to try the kind of food
you see in picture books...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Besides, I thought if it's the same as the book, Robroy-san might enjoy her meal even more—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Rice-san...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, Rice and I have been holding tea parties
to recreate it, trying our hand at all sorts of dishes each time.
choice_data_list: Huh! I can't wait to see what kind of dish it is!
Huh! I can't wait to see what kind of dish it is!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, it should be done baking soon!
Rice will go check the oven...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, preparations steadily progressed,
and dishes were laid out across the table—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they're done...!
The pie is baked to absolute perfection!!
And the scones smell incredible too...!
choice_data_list: What a gorgeous table, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Laid out across the table in an overflowing spread
were numerous authentic British dishes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Scones, sandwiches, salads, cheese,
platters of food, and even dessert—
eating them all together was the custom back then!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's dig in! Um...
"Come, partake! Forget your woes, forget tomorrow,
and let us feast upon this table with great delight!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With so many dishes before me, I can't decide,
which one should I eat first...?
choice_data_list: Let's go with the pie dish on the right!
I think I'll have the soup on the left.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
This is fish pie!
I tried adding smoked haddock,
which is a type of smoked cod!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking a bite of the pie right away—
choice_data_list: Delicious! The smoky flavor is great!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Really! Yay...!
Rice-san, it's a success...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we did it...! It's all because you researched so hard and did your best, Rob Roy-san!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all thanks to you, Rice-san...!
You gave me so much advice while we were cooking...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-Rice only helped out a little...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-But whenever I cook with Rob Roy-san,
it's always fun and turns out delicious... ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, over a delicious meal, I spent a peaceful time together with Zenno Rob Roy and the others.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Cullen Skink, right...! It's a smoked fish
soup boiled in milk, originating from a Scottish
village called Cullen!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: In the story, the heartless protagonist reforms and serves this soup to a little Umamusume, and that scene is just so touching...! The social backdrop of that era, too—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... My apologies... I got carried away...
Let's eat before it gets cold...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Tell me lots of your stories, Rob Roy-san,
while we drink our soup...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, alongside a delicious meal, I spent a peaceful time listening to Zenno Rob Roy's lecture on literature.
